title: Iran Insists Strait of Hormuz Will Stay Closed Until Trump Agrees to Demands
summary_full: A spokesman for the Iranian Foreign Ministry said that talks with Oman on shipping routes in the Strait of Hormuz were “separate” from discussions to fully reopen the waterway.
